styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool-toned hygiene ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, icy light blue #D9EAF6, primary blue #1B87C9 and one sparing red badge accent #E23A2E; bright soft cool studio lighting with airy high-key glow and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; rounded rectangular info cards with thin-line blue outline icons; water splash and bubble motifs allowed at the product base; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 10 张 800x1200 详情页长图切片（重叠约 60px）提炼。源文件夹名为「保健」，以图为准判定为 护肤个护/清洁消毒（75% 酒精皮肤及多场景免洗消毒喷雾，标签标注外用、适用肤质所有肤质）。已剥离：源品牌标签文案与版式、具体杀菌率数字（99%、99.99%、30S 等，改以 {callout_n} 交由使用方填写，不生成虚构数据）、菌种名单文案（大肠杆菌等）、FRESH BREATH 残留英文、二维码会员贴片、手机/平板品牌外观；人物仅保留手部特写角色，无面部身份。
